title: SS - OPEX MAINTENANCE
agency_path: TREASURY, DEPARTMENT OF THE.INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE.TAXPAYER FOCUSED SUPPORT
detail_text: SOURCES SOUGHT: THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (RFP), REQUEST FOR QUOTATIONS (RFQ), OR INVITATION FOR BIDS (IFB). NO SOLICITATION IS AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME. This notice is issued in accordance with FAR Part 10 for market research and acquisition planning purposes only. The Government does not intend to award a contract based on responses to this notice. The Internal Revenue Service (IRS), Campus Support (AM/SITE), is conducting market research to identify capable vendors to provide maintenance and repair services for three (3) OPEX Omation 206 mail slicing machines and associated batchers. These machines are used to perform the initial slicing of incoming mail.
